permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.subtitle: Presets only change what gets asked; deny rules are never relaxed
permissions.presetHint_loose: Ask only for critical risk; common read-only tools bypass
permissions.presetHint_standard: Ask on high / critical; bash and write ask every time
permissions.presetHint_strict: Ask from medium up; every call goes through a card
permissions.rulesHint: allow / ask / deny rules; deny > ask > allow
permissions.grantsHint: Session or one-time grants; revoke at any time
permissions.statusCustomNote: · matches none of the three presets
permissions.statusScopeNote: Presets only gate the chat assistant; employee runs drop bash / write from the ask list
permissions.floorNote: These commands are evaluated before any allow rule and before the preset, so an allow rule cannot lift them.
permissions.floorNoteExtra: A separate set of destructive PS verbs is blocked inside the engine and is neither listed nor configurable.
permissions.diffHint: Before switching, see what it asks more or less than now
permissions.savePending: Preset will change to {name} and take effect immediately
permissions.prioNote: An allow rule disables the preset ask list; the deny floor ignores every rule
permissions.syntaxHint: Syntax: read whole tool · bash:git status exact · bash:npm:* prefix · write:src/** wildcard. Invalid patterns fail silently.
permissions.grantsFoldHint: From Allow for this session · whole tool for 24h
permissions.grantsNote: Every entry comes from Allow for this session on a permission card: the whole tool stops asking in that session, even when arguments change. Revoking restores per-call approval immediately, no restart needed.
